highlights: Iconify technology and developer icon collections

New.title: Auth method action buttons
New.description: Administrators can add icon buttons to auth-method screens for common links and form requests, with mount-specific settings, reusable context placeholders, and configurable tab or popup behavior.

New.title: Iconify auth action icons
New.description: Choose icons from popular technology, developer, and general-purpose collections when configuring auth-method action buttons.

Improved.title: Persistent auth action configuration
Improved.description: Auth action buttons are stored in the same persistent configuration volume as the rest of VaultLens settings, so they survive pod restarts.

Improved.title: Faster auth action icon search
Improved.description: Searching the large auth action icon catalog is now more responsive while you type.

Improved.title: Icon-only auth actions
Improved.description: Auth action buttons can now show only their selected icon while keeping the button label available as a tooltip when users hover over it.

highlights: Faster browsing with search across secrets and access pages
Audit error visibility for auth methods and roles

New.title: Agent secret import links
New.description: Open a prepared secret draft from Claude, Codex, or another tool in the VaultLens editor for review. Nothing is saved until you confirm the change.

New.title: Move secrets
New.description: Move an individual secret or an entire folder of secrets to another KV path. Existing destinations are shown before anything changes, so you can skip or overwrite conflicts.

New.title: Search across secrets and access pages
New.description: Search secret keys, auth methods, and identity groups directly from their list pages to find what you need faster.

New.title: Application settings backup
New.description: Back up and restore VaultLens's own configuration — feature toggles, branding, sharing options, webhooks, backup schedule, and custom developer integration guides — separately from your Vault secrets. Available from the Backup & Restore admin page.

New.title: Auth method error badges
New.description: The auth method page and its roles list now show a small red counter when recent audit errors are found for that backend or role. Click the badge to open a filtered audit log popup scoped to just those errors.

New.title: Header information links
New.description: The public landing page has been removed so the app opens directly at login or the dashboard, with optional information links available in the header.

New.title: Generic Lens Audit events
New.description: Lens Audits now use a consistent event format that can cover authentication, sharing, and future VaultLens features with an action, status, actor, target, and event details.

New.title: Selectable scheduled backup types
New.description: The backup schedule now lets you choose Vault backup, VaultLens settings backup, or both. The scheduler runs whichever types are selected on every due occurrence.

Improved.title: Container runtime hardening
Improved.description: VaultLens containers now run as an unprivileged user and keep shell commands disabled unless debugging is explicitly enabled.

Improved.title: Persisted developer guide overrides
Improved.description: Custom developer integration guide overrides now live on the same mounted configuration volume as the rest of VaultLens's settings, so they survive container restarts and upgrades instead of resetting.

Improved.title: Audit buffer memory estimate
Improved.description: The Analytics page now shows an estimated memory footprint for the in-memory audit buffer.

Improved.title: Remembered OIDC role
Improved.description: The login page remembers the last OIDC role used in this browser and preselects it for the next sign-in.

Fixed.title: Restricted secret partial updates
Fixed.description: Masked values are cleared when you edit a restricted secret field, so replacement text is saved without the mask. Empty fields are ignored and restore their placeholder when left unchanged.

highlights: Secret version history with diff comparison
Audit log pause and right-click context menu
Create webhooks directly from audit entries

New.title: Secret version history
New.description: Browse every version of a KV v2 secret, compare any two versions side by side with a colour-coded diff (green = added, red = removed), and restore a previous version as the new current version — all without leaving the secret detail page.

New.title: Audit log pause button
New.description: Freeze the live auto-refresh while you inspect an entry. A 'updates pending' badge appears so you know new events have arrived. The selected row stays expanded and highlighted when you resume.

New.title: Right-click audit log entries
New.description: Right-click any audit log row to copy the path, user display name, or the full entry as JSON. A 'Create webhook…' option opens a pre-filled webhook form using the entry's path and identity fields.

New.title: Create webhook from audit entry
New.description: The new webhook popup pre-fills the secret path pattern from the selected audit entry. At the bottom it shows all existing webhooks and highlights which ones already match the entry's path, so you can avoid duplicates.

New.title: AppRole secret ID generation
New.description: Generate new Secret IDs for AppRole roles directly in the UI. The Secret ID is displayed once at creation and never shown again — copy it before closing. Existing secret ID accessors are listed (masked to first and last two characters) so you can track and revoke them individually.

New.title: Creator / modifier metadata stamping
New.description: An optional setting (Features → Secrets) automatically adds _created_by, _created_at, _updated_by, and _updated_at to KV v2 custom metadata on every write from VaultLens. Disabled by default.

New.title: What's New (this panel)
New.description: A release changelog is now bundled with VaultLens. An unread dot appears on your user menu whenever a new version is deployed. Dismiss this panel to mark the version as seen.

Improved.title: Version dropdown on secret detail
Improved.description: A version selector appears next to Edit/Delete for KV v2 secrets with multiple versions. Switching versions preserves any revealed values if you had Show All active.

Improved.title: Version history table in metadata
Improved.description: The Metadata accordion on the secret detail page now shows a full version history table with Created, Status (Current / Active / Deleted / Destroyed), and per-row Restore and Compare actions.

Improved.title: Audit log right-click in auth method detail
Improved.description: The embedded audit log inside Auth Method → Role Detail also gains the right-click context menu and webhook creation modal.

highlights: Full KV v1 and v2 secrets management
Auth methods, entities, groups, and ACL policies

New.title: Secrets engine browser
New.description: Browse and manage KV v1 and v2 secrets across all mounted engines. Create, edit, merge partial updates, and delete secrets with full restricted-access support.

New.title: Auth methods management
New.description: View, configure, and manage all Vault auth methods including Kubernetes, GitHub, OIDC, AppRole, and LDAP. Manage roles, tune settings, and see per-method audit logs.

New.title: Identity — entities and groups
New.description: Browse Vault identity entities and groups, view aliases, policies, and memberships. Visualise identity relationships with the built-in graph view.

New.title: ACL policies viewer
New.description: List, read, and parse ACL policies. View per-path capabilities and simulate what any entity can do on any path via the Permission Tester.

New.title: Secret auto-rotation
New.description: Configure rotation intervals on any KV v2 secret using custom_metadata. A background scheduler rotates secrets automatically and supports per-key format overrides.

New.title: Backup and restore
New.description: Manual and scheduled full KV backups. Download, restore, or delete snapshots. Supports configurable cron-style schedules.

New.title: End-to-end encrypted secret sharing
New.description: Share secrets via URL with OpenPGP encryption. The decryption key lives in the URL fragment — the server never sees it. Supports one-time view, OTP-protected, and login-required modes.

New.title: Webhook notifications
New.description: Configure HTTP webhooks that fire when audit log events match a path pattern and optional field filters. Test delivery from the UI.

New.title: Analytics dashboard
New.description: View Vault health, seal status, token and entity counters, and host info at a glance.

New.title: React Flow visualisations
New.description: Interactive graph views for auth-method → policy, policy → secret path, and identity relationships.

New.title: Custom branding
New.description: Set a custom app name, logo, and primary colour. Config is stored in the pluggable config backend and applied to all users.

New.title: OIDC login
New.description: Sign in via any configured OIDC/JWT auth method using a popup flow. No redirect away from the app.
